history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration ensure that UNAMA strengthen the training of staff members responsible to ensure the proper recording of fuel data and regularly monitor and analyse fuel consumption in order to identify and investigate irregular fuel consumption.
history.administration_response: UNAMA conducted refresher training on 3 May 2021 for the staff who are engaged in handling fuel. In accordance with the recommendation made in March 2021, the Mission was able to complete the installation of electronic fuel management system-compliant metres in all generator houses. Pictures of installed meters can be provided as evidence. Fuel consumption is being monitored on a monthly basis, and irregular consumption, if any, is immediately investigated and the necessary corrective action is initiated immediately.
history.board_assessment: Given the efforts made and the supporting documents provided, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
